scenario.name: targeted web subset (bundle-w7 plan §7), NOT perf/run.sh web all: activity-log (all 10 cases), one-on-ones --persona lead (own/managed/team/drilldown), dashboard --persona ceo (managers/peers/subordinates/myTeams), pulse-results --persona hr (results/trend/participation), org-chart (admin/ic/ceo), days-off --persona ceo and --persona lead (calendar scopes, requests, team), the bundle report (perf/run.sh web bundle), plus one k6 sanity run reviews-team-view --persona ceo-all (1 VU, 3 iterations, pgss window, no warm-up). The runner has no login/first-load case.
scenario.compareWith: web: 2026-10-04-9c2e5c0f/web (activity-log, one-on-ones lead, pulse-results hr, org-chart) and 2026-10-04-3076bbd4/web (dashboard ceo, days-off ceo/lead — absent from 9c2e5c0f; that baseline predates the v4.14.0/v4.15.0 API fixes, so its api.stmt differs by design); bundle: 2026-10-04-3076bbd4/bundle.json. Compare with jq, not perf_compare.py.
scenario.report: report-vs-2026-10-04-9c2e5c0f.md: every count identical (15 requests / 183 stmt / 84 tx, every per-chain and per-endpoint stmt/tx); no RUN NOT CLEAN; the only flags are a p95 wall blip on the reviews request (7.6 -> 9.6 ms, 3 samples) and pg_stat_statements IN-list text-variant shifts (total calls 817 = 817).
scenario.webApiNote: per-request statement counts unchanged; several screens issue ONE request fewer (1:1 lead own 6 -> 5, days-off calendar-member/requests -1, pulse participation/results/trend -1): with the 300 ms Suspense throttle gone the page mounts together with the shell, so React Query dedupes the shell query it shares instead of refetching it on mount ~300 ms later. The activity log's own request +1..2 statements is data-dependent (the runner's sign-ins add account_events rows to the first page), no code change.
scenario.knownNotClean: none: 0 failed requests and 0 responses without Server-Timing

caveat: OrbStack on one laptop, loopback network, development-mode app image: milliseconds are relative; counts and byte sizes exact. Baselines compare only within one datasetVersion.
fixes: v4.15.1: W1 (first-route preload + synchronous lazyPage render — the ~300 ms Suspense fallback throttle is gone: the screen's first own request starts with the shell's at ~52-65 ms instead of ~274 ms; activity-log.ceo.own settled 292.6 -> 108.6 ms, LCP 276 -> 84 ms), W7 (initial payload 38 files / 1 726 732 B raw / 480 717 gzip / 405 060 brotli -> 8 files / 1 245 851 / 333 387 / 282 109, entry 116.5 KiB raw; CI budget --max-initial-gzip 360000 --max-initial-files 12 passes; staticCount on the activity screen 67 -> 42, decoded 1 816 194 -> 1 604 114 B).
